protocol: Canonical Intent Dictionary — Phase 0 of the Execution Registry initiative (owner, 2026-07-17). v2: added invariants (normative, not descriptive), allowed_extension_points/forbidden, stability, and variants (architecture-neutral — does NOT force a business decision about merging/splitting document types).
note: Defines MEANING and CONSTITUTION before implementation. Root cause this closes: registry/rule-coverage.json's own Rule 101 entry already stated 'nothing scans intent or purpose, only file names and import edges' — this file is that missing layer. Does NOT touch code, does NOT change behavior. Grounded only in intents actually traced this session — no invented/aspirational intents. Confidence/open_question fields stay honest rather than guessed, per this codebase's own consciousness-layer rule ("ระบบมีสิทธิ์ไม่รู้ แต่ไม่มีสิทธิ์เดาแล้วนำเสนอเป็นความจริง"). IMPORTANT: `invariants` are NORMATIVE — the rule every implementation of that intent SHOULD satisfy, not a claim that current code already does. `invariant_compliance` on each known_implementation is the honest, evidence-based audit of whether it actually does — several show false on purpose, because that's the real, current state this file is supposed to expose, not hide.
created_by: Owner + Claude, Invoice Workflow Redesign session — direct continuation of the document.send call-graph audit that found 5 competing implementations (A-E)

next_phases.phase_1: execution-registry.json — binds each intent below to ONE canonical implementation; validates against this file's invariants instead of checking file names
next_phases.phase_2: Migration — collapse the known document.send implementations into the canonical one, until invariant_compliance is true for all invariants
next_phases.phase_3: Intent Guard — pre-commit check that reads THIS file, rejects a new implementation of an intent that already has canonical_status: DECIDED, prompts Extend/Replace/Abort using allowed_extension_points
next_phases.phase_4: registry/invariants.json (repo-wide layer, e.g. communication_backbone/execution_pipeline immutability) — a superset of the per-intent invariants here

document.send.definition: Deliver a business document that already exists as a persisted row, to the customer via a messaging platform.
document.send.variants_note: Architecture-neutral list — records that these document_type values exist and currently share (mostly) one delivery mechanism. Does NOT decide whether they are one intent or several; that is a Business-layer decision explicitly deferred, not made here.
document.send.stability_reason: Central revenue-facing action; the incident that started this whole initiative (5 competing send paths) happened here specifically.
document.send.canonical_status: DECIDED for the invoice variant (2026-07-18): A (gateway/actions.ts::sendInvoiceToLine) is canonical. Both real UI callers (app/admin/relationships/workspace.tsx and app/admin/line-customers/page.tsx) now route invoice sends/resends through it via the Retry Send endpoint — verified by direct grep, 0 remaining invoice-table callers of E. B and E remain the live implementations for the other variants (quotation/receipt/delivery_order/billing_note via B, standalone_documents re-send via E) because neither has an invoice_items-equivalent items table yet — deliberately deferred, not forgotten.

invariants.must_use_execution_pipeline: Every caller reaches delivery through one shared pipeline function, never a route-local reimplementation.
invariants.must_not_call_line_api_directly: Only the LINE Adapter layer calls api.line.me — business/route code never does.
invariants.must_have_audit: Every send writes a durable record of what was sent, to whom, and when.
invariants.must_update_delivery_status: The source document's own status field reflects whether it was actually sent.
invariants.must_register_entry_point: Every caller of this intent is listed in execution-registry.json — no unregistered caller exists.
invariants.must_not_create_parallel_pipeline: No new file may reimplement build-flex+push-LINE for this intent.

entry_points: app/api/chat/confirm/route.ts (auto-called after ConfirmInvoice succeeds, invoice type only)

app/api/admin/invoices/[invoiceId]/send/route.ts (Retry Send — as of 2026-07-18, real UI callers: app/admin/relationships/workspace.tsx::sendDocument() and app/admin/line-customers/page.tsx::sendDocument(), both only for doc.table==='invoices')

invariant_compliance.must_have_audit: partial — writes to line_events (a message log), no dedicated audit.delivery record
invariant_compliance.must_not_create_parallel_pipeline: n/a — this IS one of the parallel implementations being described, not a violator of a pipeline that doesn't exist yet

known_implementations.compliance_note: Most complete of the three (has status tracking + duplicate-send guard + real line items), but still calls api.line.me directly — no adapter abstraction exists in this codebase today for ANY implementation.

entry_points: same POST /api/chat/confirm as A, branches by document_type
known_implementations.compliance_note: Least compliant — no status field on standalone_documents even exists to update, no audit trail at all.

known_implementations.scope: standalone_documents only, as of 2026-07-18 (was: any existing invoices/standalone_documents row) — the invoices branch was repointed to A. Deprecating this route for invoices is a real state change, not a status label: verified by grep, 0 remaining callers pass table:"invoices" to it.
entry_points: app/admin/line-customers/page.tsx::sendDocument() (standalone_documents branch only, separate near-duplicate function in the legacy parallel page)

invariant_compliance.must_have_audit: partial — writes to line_events, same as A

known_implementations.compliance_note: Predates invoice_items entirely — sends a Flex card with NO line items, and can re-send an already-sent invoice with no guard.

document.send.extension_points_note: template/footer/pricing_summary are REAL today (DOC_LABELS per document_type, branding.footerNote/documentTerms from company-settings, the summary object) — attachments/legal_notice/ai_summary are valid future extension surfaces with no implementation yet. Both kinds belong here; this list is 'where a new feature should attach', not 'what already exists'.
document.send.forbidden_note: Honesty check: 'direct_line_api' is violated by ALL THREE known implementations today (A/B/E). Listing it as forbidden here is the target state this dictionary is meant to drive toward, not a claim it's already enforced.

document.create.definition: Persist a business document (header + line items) that was previously only a computed preview, as a real committed row in the database.
document.create.stability_reason: Financial write — the only intent in this dictionary with a real Postgres transaction (confirm_invoice RPC) behind it.
document.create.confidence: high — directly traced and rebuilt this session
document.create.canonical_status: DECIDED — gateway/actions.ts::executeDocumentCreate is canonical for all document types. For invoice specifically, calls the confirm_invoice() Postgres RPC (atomic header+items commit).

invariants.must_be_atomic: Header and line items commit together or not at all.
invariants.must_require_human_confirmation: Rule 72 — no write without a consumed preview_token.
invariants.must_not_recompute_business_values: Persists exactly what was shown in Preview (business.calculate_tax's result), never a second calculation.

invariant_compliance.must_be_atomic: true for invoice (confirm_invoice RPC) — NOT verified for standalone_documents, which still does a plain single-table insert with no items table at all
invariant_compliance.must_not_recompute_business_values: true for invoice (precomputedSummary threaded through) — NOT verified for standalone_documents

debt.notify.definition: Push a debt-reminder Flex card (outstanding balance, overdue days) to a customer, either on manual admin action or on the daily automated schedule.
debt.notify.variants_note: Unlike document.send's variants (business document types), these are delivery-trigger variants — kept separate implementations by necessity (different runtimes: Node vs Deno Edge Function), not a violation of must_not_create_parallel_pipeline.
debt.notify.stability_reason: Revenue-critical automated flow running unattended daily.
debt.notify.confidence: high — directly traced this session (during the getCurrentDebt/RLS audit)
debt.notify.canonical_status: PARTIAL — two implementations, each canonical for its own trigger type (manual vs automated), both must stay formula-synchronized manually per this codebase's documented cross-runtime-duplication convention.

invariants.must_use_single_source_of_truth_formula: Debt figure must come from getCurrentDebt()/calcDebtTrackingSummary() lineage, never a separate calculation.
invariants.must_not_send_duplicate_same_day: One reminder per customer per day, regardless of trigger.

entry_points: app/admin/line-customers/page.tsx::sendDebt() (sends no mode in its POST body — defaults to preview only; a real difference from the workspace.tsx version, not yet explained, found during Phase 0 research but not fixed here)

invariant_compliance.must_not_send_duplicate_same_day: not enforced at this layer — no same-day check found; relies on the human not clicking twice

known_implementations.trigger: automated, scheduled (10-min cron, fires once/day at configured hour)
entry_points: none — no UI, internal scheduler only

invariant_compliance.must_use_single_source_of_truth_formula: true — mirrored formula, manually kept in sync (Deno cannot import Node code)

payment.request.definition: Request or record a payment against an existing invoice/debt.
payment.request.stability_reason: Implementation exists and is real, but its own callers/UI were never traced this session — treat as less settled than document.send/debt.notify until verified.
payment.request.confidence: medium — confirmed the implementation exists and is called, but its own callers were not traced this session
payment.request.canonical_status: DECIDED (by default — only one implementation found)

invariants.must_require_human_confirmation: Rule 72 preview/execute pattern, same as document.create.

entry_points: dispatchAction({action:"payment"}) — real UI callers not traced this session, unverified

invariant_compliance.must_require_human_confirmation: presumed true (uses the same preview/execute gateway pattern) but not directly verified this session

payment.request.open_question: Whether this is a document.send-adjacent intent (e.g. sends a payment confirmation/receipt) or purely a data-write with no messaging component — not verified. Do not assume either answer.

partner.message.definition: Send a free-text (non-document) message to a customer's LINE — a reply, a notification, or an AI-drafted message.
partner.message.stability_reason: Boundaries of this intent (vs approval.request) are not yet settled — see open_question. Treat as unstable until that decision is made.
partner.message.confidence: low — names/boundaries were inferred from file discovery this session, not deeply traced
partner.message.canonical_status: NOT DECIDED — at least 2 real, separately-implemented mechanisms found

invariants.must_require_human_confirmation_if_ai_dr: An AI-proposed message must sit in a pending-review state until a human approves it (Rule 72).

known_implementations.note: Sends a human-editable, AI-drafted plain-text message from line_outbound_drafts pending review. Comment states it shares 'same LINE push call as app/api/admin/notifications/send/route.ts' — a third file not yet examined.
Calls POST /api/chat/confirm — may actually route through the SAME endpoint as document.send (A/B), not a separate mechanism. Not confirmed.

partner.message.open_question: Is 'approval.request' a distinct intent from 'partner.message', or simply the Rule-72-gated PRECONDITION every send intent already has? Needs a real decision before Phase 1 can register either one.

explicitly_not_yet_defined: any Facebook/WhatsApp/Email/Instagram intent — no implementation of any kind exists in this codebase today; do not pre-define an intent for a platform with zero real code to ground it in
